You know that sinking feeling when the lights go out and you realize your phone is about to die? 😅 It’s the worst time for our tech to let us down! That’s why I like to keep a few handy tips in mind whenever a blackout strikes. It’s all about being prepared and having some fun alternatives ready to go. Just remember, a little planning can turn an unexpected power outage into a cozy family adventure!
